title: SIH26059 Trajectory Prediction Output
description: Canonical output schema produced by src/output_writer.py::build_json_structure and written by write_predictions_json. One array element per (iceberg_id, prediction_timestamp) group.

iceberg_id.description: Identifier matching the input dataset's iceberg_id (or its configured column mapping).

prediction_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent real observation this prediction was made from. Null only if the source timestamp itself was invalid/missing (NaT).

predictions.description: One entry per configured prediction horizon for this iceberg's latest observation.

horizon_hours.description: Hours ahead of prediction_timestamp this entry predicts. One of the values in config.yaml -> prediction.horizons_hours (currently 6, 12, 24, 48).

predicted_latitude.description: Predicted latitude in degrees. Null if this horizon is unsupported for this iceberg (no trained model and no real movement history for the dead-reckoning baseline) - never a fabricated value.

predicted_longitude.description: Predicted longitude in degrees. Null under the same condition as predicted_latitude.

uncertainty_km.description: Empirical uncertainty (kilometres) derived from real held-out validation error at this horizon (see uncertainty.method in config.yaml, default RMSE). Null whenever no real validation has been performed yet for this horizon - this is the expected state before Person 5's dataset is validated against, not an error.
